Execute default Scrape action and verify extracted content

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'browser' => { 'mode' => 'always' } }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.interact(engine, url, [{ 'type' => 'scrape' }])
puts result.action_results[0].success.inspect
puts result.action_results[0].action_type.inspect
puts result.action_results[0].data.inspect
```
